question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

 LAGGARD
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delayed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Laggard"** refers to someone or something that is slow or falls behind others in movement, development, or progress. (धीमा या पिछड़ने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The company was a laggard in adopting new technology, which affected its market share.
 

 
• **"Delayed"** means something that is postponed, late, or slow to happen. (विलंबित)
 
 
• **Example:** The delayed flight caused inconvenience to the passengers waiting at the airport.</l
